asr_text: But the jumps were not the only thing to watch. In the test, the island and conversation reset every hour. But the work area with the AI's notes and programs carried over to the next hour. The island went back to how it was before, but the AI's discoveries stayed. So would this experience help the AI when it was asked to work again? The researchers compared 13 AIs with island experience. They also used 13 AIs with the setup, but no experience. On a new island, the task was to build as many towers as possible in one hour. Each tower had to be five blocks high. The researchers checked which AIs could build more than two towers. The experienced group did better. Those that had taken a tour we're now one step ahead.
